A failure can be detected during inspection, testing, post-maintenance testing (PMT), non-testing, or ESF demand. • Overall, the most likely detection method for all three failure modes is test demand. Non-test demand and inspection are the two other main detection methods. • For FTOP, while the most likely detection method for low-demand MOVs is test demand, the detection method for high-demand MOVs is dominated by non-test demand.
